_about: What each Dealo (Hubble) voucher can't pay for, shown in the red 'Things it can't pay for' box on the voucher card. Picked by hand from Hubble's own terms for the top shops (2026-11-09). Each item's quote must appear word for word in that voucher's live Hubble terms; when Hubble changes the wording the item is dropped automatically (hubble_service.card_details), so a stale pick never shows. Keys are hubble_service.normalize(Hubble voucher name). Icons: ring coins cash plane bus home tag store truck gift receipt film phone pill.
